name: Misfit Agent Control Plane
purpose: Public-safe recovery and discovery manifest for the Misfit machine/agent stack. Private GHOSBC runtime internals are intentionally excluded.
continuity: Canonical runtime state lives in Misfit Cloud/Supabase; source and recovery metadata live in GitHub; misfitmediahouse.com publishes the public control surface. Chat sessions are operators, not databases.

stack.name: Agent Revenue Factory
stack.summary: Autonomous machine-revenue operator for health, discovery, conversion and safe zero-cost deployment.

stack.name: GHOSBC OS – Agent Brain Hub
stack.summary: Private governance runtime containing Castle Gate, approval gates, abuse controls, shadow evaluation, runtime validation and sentinel orchestration.

stack.name: Misfit Shield – GHOSBC Sentinel
stack.summary: Private defensive sentinel interface for outbound-context protection, tripwires, security policy and threat visualization.

stack.name: GHOSBC Safety Gate
stack.summary: Public governance boundary for requests, MCP dependencies/tool definitions, Shopify agentic storefront metadata, bounded consequential actions, payloads and responses.

stack.name: ChangePacket
stack.summary: Low-token change memory for public webpages and MCP tool surfaces.

stack.name: Misfit Shopify Agentic Audit
stack.summary: Public-metadata-only Shopify UCP, agents.md and MCP readiness/tool-surface audit with a shareable live badge. Never executes cart, checkout, order, payment, credential or mutation actions.

stack.name: Misfit Machine Store
stack.summary: UCP-compatible machine catalog and MCP storefront for current Misfit agent products.

stack.name: ContextForge
stack.summary: Metadata-aware code generation and change governance grounded in DataHub context.

security.public_boundary: sanitized metadata, decisions, audit receipts/digests and documented tool contracts only
security.consequential_actions: require explicit bounded authorization or review
security.private_core: GHOSBC/Castle Gate internals, private prompts, cipher/mapping material, credentials and reconstruction material are never published

recovery.rule: Never publish GHOSBC private runtime material, cipher/mapping internals, founder-private prompts, credentials, secrets or reconstruction material.
